'''High Priest''' (or '''[[High Priestess/Legends|High Priestess]]''') was a title used for a ranking member of a religious organization.

The [[Ithorian religion]] and civil society were led by a High Priest. [[Momaw Nadon/Legends|Momaw Nadon]] and [[Relal Tawron]] were two such leaders.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], High Priest [[Cardo (Sedrian)|Cardo]] led [[Sedrian]] society as the [[High Priest of the Golden Sun|leader]] of the [[Priests of the Sun]].<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>

High Priests were members of the [[Priest caste]], and highly regarded by members of [[Yuuzhan Vong]] society.

[[Teroenza]] was the High Priest of [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]].
